name: 00_boot_with_glb
setup: g.__gpBoot = (async () => { const A = await import('/src/core/Assets.js'); const assets = new A.Assets({ materials: g.materials, palette: g.palette }); await assets.loadManifest(); g.assets = assets; const m = await import('/src/systems/GameplayBoot.js'); const gp = await m.installGameplay(g, { seedDemo: true, quality: 'low', assets }); g.gameplay = gp; const base = g.step.bind(g); g.step = (dt) => { base(dt); try { gp.update(dt, null); } catch (e) { window.__GP_ERR = String(e && e.stack || e); } }; window.__GLB = { surveyor: gp.surveyor.usingGlb, hands: !!gp.hands.usingGlbHands, lamp: !!gp.flashlight.usingGlbBody }; })().catch(e => { window.__GP_ERR = String(e && e.stack || e); }); g.look(-27.0, 0, -8.4, -1.5708, 0.02);

name: 03_glb_surveyor_full
setup: if (!g.gameplay) return; g.gameplay.inventory.take('fuse_core', 1); g.gameplay.qa.lamp(false); g.gameplay.qa.surveyorTo(-20.5, -8.4, -1.5708); g.gameplay.qa.pose(0.9, 0.4); g.look(-27.0, 0, -8.4, -1.5708, 0.10);

name: 08_glb_surveyor_capture
setup: if (!g.gameplay) return; g.gameplay.qa.surveyorTo(-25.9, -8.4, -1.5708); const s = g.gameplay.surveyor; s.captureBlend = 1; s.state = 'CAPTURING'; g.gameplay.qa.pose(0.2, 0.0); g.look(-27.0, 0, -8.4, -1.5708, 0.36);
